title: Coordinate groups for shifted DG character duals
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $A$ be an associative unital DG integer algebra and $M$ a right DG $A$-module as in [def-sfb-dg-derived-category], and let $k,t\in\mathbf Z$. For any underlying integer cochain complex $C$, put $D_C^r=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf Z}(C^{-r},\mathbf Q/\mathbf Z)$ and $d_D^{r,s}(\lambda)=(-1)^{r+1}\lambda\circ d_C^{-s,-r}$ (used for $s=r+1$). Define $Z_C^k=\ker d_D^{k,k+1}$, $B_C^k=Z_C^k\cap\operatorname{im}d_D^{k-1,k}$, and $H_C^k=Z_C^k/B_C^k$. Define $G_{A,M,k}^t$ as the group of additive families $\phi^p:M^p\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf Z}(A^{-p-t-k},\mathbf Q/\mathbf Z)$ with $\phi(ma)(b)=\phi(m)(ab)$ for all homogeneous $m,a,b$ in the indicated degrees. Define $\operatorname{Maps}_{A,k}(M)$ as the subgroup of $G_{A,M,k}^0$ satisfying $\phi^{p+1}(d_Mm)(b)=(-1)^{p+1}\phi^p(m)(d_Ab)$, where $m\in M^p$ and $b\in A^{-p-1-k}$. This is the coordinate presentation of degree-zero right-linear chain maps to $A^\vee[k]$, with $(A^\vee[k])^p=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf Z}(A^{-p-k},\mathbf Q/\mathbf Z)$, differential $(-1)^{p+1}$ times precomposition by $d_A$, and right action $(\lambda a)(b)=\lambda(ab)$. Define the subgroup of null maps as the subgroup generated by those $f$ admitting $h\in G_{A,M,k}^{-1}$ with $f^p(m)(b)=(-1)^p h^p(m)(d_Ab)+h^{p+1}(d_Mm)(b)$ for all $m\in M^p$, $b\in A^{-p-k}$; equivalently it is precisely the null-homotopic maps since this set is an additive subgroup. Define $\operatorname{HMaps}_{A,k}(M)$ as the quotient of Maps by that subgroup. The distinguished element $1\in A^0$ is the value at $1\in\mathbf Z$ of the monoid-object unit in degree zero.
